customDescriptions.value: Execute a subsystem using dataflow scheduling for automatic parallelism — use to exploit multi-core CPUs by letting the scheduler determine optimal execution order and buffering
Detect anomalies in time-series signals using a trained deep learning model — use for predictive maintenance, fault detection, or quality monitoring on streaming sensor data
Access demonstration models for DSP System Toolbox workflows — use as reference implementations for filtering, spectral analysis, and signal processing pipelines
Estimate signal parameters including power spectrum, autocorrelation, and frequency content — use for spectral analysis, system identification, or adaptive filtering applications
Design and apply digital filters (FIR, IIR, adaptive, multirate) to signals — use for noise removal, band selection, decimation, or interpolation in signal processing pipelines
Extract frequency-domain features (spectral centroid, bandwidth, roll-off) from signals — use for condition monitoring, audio classification, or vibration analysis feature engineering
Display DSP System Toolbox version and configuration information — use to verify toolbox installation and compatibility
Perform matrix math, linear algebra, and polynomial operations on signals — use for signal transformations, system solving, or statistical computations in DSP workflows
Quantize signals to fixed-point or integer representations — use to model ADC quantization effects or prepare floating-point algorithms for fixed-point implementation
Buffer, delay, pad, and reshape signal frames — use to convert between sample-based and frame-based processing or manage signal alignment in multirate systems
Apply signal operations like convolution, correlation, interpolation, and zero-crossing detection — use for time-domain signal manipulation and feature extraction
Display and log signals with scopes, spectrum analyzers, and array plots — use for real-time visualization and analysis of signal processing results
Generate test signals (sine, chirp, noise, pulse) and read from audio/file sources — use as inputs to DSP processing chains for development and testing
Compute running statistics (mean, variance, histogram, min/max) on streaming signals — use for online signal monitoring and statistical characterization
Extract time-domain features (RMS, crest factor, kurtosis, peak-to-peak) from signals — use for condition monitoring or signal characterization without transforming to frequency domain
Apply spectral and time-frequency transforms (FFT, DCT, Hilbert, spectrogram) — use to convert signals between time and frequency domains for analysis or processing
Compute wavelet scattering transform coefficients for robust signal representation — use for signal classification tasks where translation-invariant features outperform raw spectral content
